designationHistory.name: Gravel Island Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President William Howard Taft established the Gravel Island Reservation by Executive Order 1678; it is now Gravel Island National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Gravel Island National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
USFWS, Green Bay and Gravel Island NWRs Draft Comprehensive Conservation Plan (GovInfo GOVPUB-I49-PURL-gpo52858): "Gravel Island NWR was established by Executive Order 1678, dated January 9, 1913"
American Presidency Project: Proclamation 2416, Changing the Names of Certain Federal Wildlife Refuges (July 25, 1940), lists former and new names

review.note: EO 1678, 1913-01-09 (William Howard Taft). Draft date field held "1678" (the EO number) and signer "Executive Order". Signed by Taft (in office until Mar. 4, 1913). Former name Gravel Island Reservation per Proclamation 2416.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Gravel Island National Wildlife Refuge was established by Executive Order 1678.
